title: Islamic Chatbots in the Age of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and qualitative analysis assessing the risk of 'Bias Leakage,' where Islamophobic tropes, cultural stereotypes, and securitized framings from foundational general-purpose LLMs are reproduced in specialized Islamic chatbots.

Conceptual analysis and taxonomy classification of chatbots based on 'Sectarian Encoding' to evaluate how systems represent different Islamic schools of thought (e.g., Sunni vs. Shia), assessing the risk of 'Sectarian Drift' and the erasure of legitimate juristic disagreements.
